name: 文心快码
desc: China-first code completion that also reads Figma files
desc_zh: 国内可直连的代码补全助手
solves: Completion that needs a VPN is no completion. This one answers while you type, on a mainland network, and turns a Figma file into a page when the design arrives.
solves_zh: 要翻墙才能用的补全等于没有补全。这个在国内网络下边写边补，设计稿到了也能转成页面。
best_for: Daily coding on a mainland network, where the first constraint is that the assistant can connect.
best_for_zh: 在国内网络做日常编码，第一道约束是助手得连得上。
notes: 服务超千万开发者的国产编程助手代表，Figma 转代码是少数工具具备的能力 来源：https://comate.baidu.com/zh/page/x9rcbn4gmz2
